_what: Proposed replacement for client/ui/tokens.json, built from Screens v3 (Claude Design) under v3.6 §23.5: where the document states a value it stays as `value` and the design's is kept as `design`; where the document is silent the design's value is adopted and cited. Units: points (pt) of the client's 360-point base frame, read 1:1 from the design's 390-px frame (see design-system.md §10.1). Groups `color`, `size`, `motion`, `color_high_contrast`, `shape`, `text_scale`, `haptics` keep tokens.gd's shape; the new groups are read by new accessors.

ink.from: §21.2 neutrals, §21.8 'Ink #221C3A'; the design writes #2A1A10 on light surfaces (167 colour declarations) — document wins until §21.8 is amended (DS-1)

ink_line.from: Screens v3: every outline (892 uses; '2px solid #1A0C14' 336 borders); §21.8 icons 'a 2-point outline' names no colour

ink_deep.from: Screens v3: law-icon ink and tab strokes (icons_schools.js:54 ink, screens_main.js:663) (345 uses)

drop.from: Screens v3: the hard drop shadow under leather and dark controls (199 uses), e.g. screens_main.js:145

paper.from: §21.2 neutrals; also the design's body text colour on night (screens_main.markup.html:308)

parchment_top.from: Screens v3 light card top (screens_meta: 'linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFBF0,#F1E3C4)', 28 uses) — §21.8 says paper panels; see DS-1

parchment_text_2.from: Screens v3 secondary text on parchment (5.81:1 on #F1E3C4)

parchment_text_3.from: Screens v3 tertiary/kicker text on parchment (4.64:1 on #F1E3C4: at the floor; never lighter)

night_top.from: Screens v3 sub-screen backdrop 'radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 50% at 50% 0%,#2E1F5E 0%,#140C30 55%,#0A0620 100%)' (15 uses)

night_mid.from: Screens v3, as above; also screens_meta.markup.html:7 html,body

glass.from: Screens v3 HUD pills over the world: rgba(20,10,22,.78) (screens_main.markup.html:393)

text_on_night.from: Screens v3 primary text on night and cards (15.75:1 on #1A1134)

text_on_night_2.from: Screens v3 secondary text #B8A8D8 is 8.21:1 but APCA Lc 58 (bold or 24 pt only); #D8CCF2 reaches Lc 76-78 on card and night (DS-6)

text_on_night_3.from: Screens v3 tertiary text #8A7AA8 (4.63:1, Lc 34) fails APCA at every size used; raised to the design's secondary, for bold words only (DS-6)

leather_light.from: Screens v3 leather 'radial-gradient(circle at 50% 28%,#6A3E52 0%,#3A2030 55%,#1E1018 100%)' (37 uses), screens_main.js:145

leather_rim.from: Screens v3 inset rim on leather (screens_main.js:145) = §21.2 Motion shadow

gold_rim.from: Screens v3 inset rim and border on gold (127 uses)

gold_drop.from: Screens v3 hard drop under gold (149 uses)

text_on_gold.from: Screens v3 screens_main.js:136 (9.51:1, Lc 67 on #E9B65C: bold only; 6.01:1, Lc 47 on #C88A35: keep words off the bottom stop)

cream.from: Screens v3 (242 uses): plate text, highlights

alarm_light.from: Screens v3 top stop of red fills and red words on night (7.97:1 on #1A1134)

alarm_fill.from: D72 (client); the design's red fills end at #C42040 (white on it 5.79:1, Lc 83); either carries words, #E2536B does not (3.69:1)

alarm_text.from: D72 (client): alarm words on light surfaces (6.41:1 on parchment #F1E3C4)

alarm_text_on_night.from: Screens v3 red words on night (9.29:1, Lc 63 on #140C30); #E2536B there is 5.05:1 but Lc 37 (DS-6)

success_light.from: Screens v3 green words on night (11.39:1, Lc 82 on #261A4C)

success_text.from: D72 (client): success words on light surfaces (6.48:1 on #F1E3C4); the design's #2F7A45/#1F8A55 there are 4.14/4.21:1

text_on_success.from: Screens v3 dark words on green fills (5.47:1 on #3FBF7F)

warn.from: Screens v3 amber for the first three alarm bells and 'listening' (screens_main.js:465); document silent

band_quiet.from: Screens v3 screens_main.js:90 BANDS (§5.5 names the bands, no colours)

sky_top.from: §21.2 day sky; the design draws one night backdrop only (screens_main.markup.html:363) — DS-9

panel.from: §21.8 paper panels at 85%; the design's panels are dark (DS-1)

alarm_fill_legacy.from: kept for tests until DS-1 is decided

gradient._what: Each is [[offset, colour token or hex], ...], top to bottom unless `angle`. A material (below) names one.

green.from: realm_diorama.js:273 and the Season CLAIM buttons

material._what: What a panel or control is made of: fill, outline, inner rim, top highlight, hard drop, soft shadow, and the colour its words take. Drawn by one shader (design-system.md §10.3); text contrast is checked against `text_bg`, the stop the words sit on.

font._what: Files under client/ui/fonts/, each with its OFL.txt; §21.11's licence ledger lists them.

ui.from: §21.8 'a rounded, friendly sans (Baloo 2) for labels and numbers, with tabular numerals'; the design sets every label and number in Manrope (DS-2)

title.from: §21.8 'Marcellus for titles and law names'; the design agrees (screens_meta.markup.html, 54 uses)

display.from: §21.8 names no display face; the design uses Lilita One for big numbers, counters and some titles (178 declarations) (DS-2)

numbers_tabular.from: §21.8 'with tabular numerals'; Manrope has tnum, Lilita One and Marcellus do not (measured)

weights.from: Manrope's Google Fonts axis ends at 800; the design's 343 'font: 900' declarations render at 800

type._what: Point sizes the components use. The design's own sizes are in `design`; `value` holds §21.8's floors (13 pt smallest, 16 pt body).

heading.from: Screens v3 section headings in Marcellus 16 ('Reminders')

hero.from: Screens v3 character and law names

number_xl.from: Screens v3 Lilita 38-40, 60 for the level-up

px_per_point.from: the client's: 1080 px for a 360-point phone; the design's 390-px frame is read as points and reflows into 360 (design-system.md §10.1)

title_points.from: Screens v3 screen titles (was 32, the client's)

corner_points.from: Screens v3 buttons and cards (92 + 77 uses of 16/14 px)

chip_height.from: §21.1 when a chip is a control; the design's chips are 30 (screens_meta.js:182)

bar_fill_ms.from: Screens v3 width .45-.6s ease-out (a value changing, not a transition)

toast_ms.from: the client's banner_ms; the design hides toasts after 1.6-2.2 s (screens_meta.js:166, 259) (DS-7)

shape._what: §21.2's shapes. Drawn from RBIcons.school (realm_diorama.js:9-16), which keeps Matter's cube edges; the clip-path polygons in screens_main.js:3-8 are an unused fallback and draw Matter as a rounded square.
